catalog_items_valid.name: catalog_items_valid
catalog_items_valid.value: "catalog_items"."version" > 0 and length(trim("catalog_items"."name")) > 0 and "catalog_items"."code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9._/-]*$' and "catalog_items"."kind" in ('goods','service') and "catalog_items"."price" between 0 and 99999999999999.9999 and "catalog_items"."unit_code" in ('NOS','KGS','LTR','MTR','HRS','DAY','OTH')

catalog_tax_valid.name: catalog_tax_valid
catalog_tax_valid.value: "catalog_tax_revisions"."revision" > 0 and "catalog_tax_revisions"."hsn_sac" ~ '^([0-9]{4}|[0-9]{6}|[0-9]{8})$' and "catalog_tax_revisions"."gst_percent" between 0 and 100 and (("catalog_tax_revisions"."category" = 'taxable' and "catalog_tax_revisions"."gst_percent" > 0) or ("catalog_tax_revisions"."category" in ('nil','exempt') and "catalog_tax_revisions"."gst_percent" = 0))

customers_valid.name: customers_valid
customers_valid.value: "customers"."version" > 0 and length(trim("customers"."name")) > 0 and "customers"."code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9._/-]*$' and jsonb_typeof("customers"."address") = 'object' and ("customers"."gstin" = '' or "customers"."gstin" ~ '^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$')

gst_registration_valid.name: gst_registration_valid
gst_registration_valid.value: "gst_registrations"."taxpayer_type" = 'regular' and "gst_registrations"."gstin" ~ '^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$' and left("gst_registrations"."gstin",2) = "gst_registrations"."state_code" and ("gst_registrations"."confirmed_at" is null) = ("gst_registrations"."confirmed_by" is null)

invoices_state_valid.name: invoices_state_valid
invoices_state_valid.value:
"invoices"."version">0 and jsonb_typeof("invoices"."draft")='object' and
    (("invoices"."document_type"='invoice' and "invoices"."original_id" is null and "invoices"."correction_reason"='') or
     ("invoices"."document_type" in ('credit_note','debit_note') and "invoices"."original_id" is not null and length(trim("invoices"."correction_reason"))>=5)) and
    ("invoices"."correction" is null or (jsonb_typeof("invoices"."correction")='object' and "invoices"."original_id" is not null)) and
    (("invoices"."status"='draft' and "invoices"."number" is null and "invoices"."financial_year" is null and "invoices"."finalized_at" is null and "invoices"."finalize_key" is null and "invoices"."finalize_digest" is null) or
     ("invoices"."status"='finalized' and "invoices"."number" is not null and "invoices"."financial_year" is not null and "invoices"."number" ~ '^[A-Z0-9/-]{1,16}$' and "invoices"."financial_year" ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' and "invoices"."finalized_at" is not null and "invoices"."finalize_key" is not null and "invoices"."finalize_digest" is not null))
